381	    "$ADR_050" 2>/dev/null || true)"
382	
383	# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 boundary note must say the invariant applies to new runs
384	# and that a resume is governed by ADR-006.
385	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says invariant applies to new runs" \
386	    "$_adr050_s6" "new run"
387	
388	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note names ADR-006 as governing resume" \
389	    "$_adr050_s6" "ADR-006"
390	
391	# ── SPEC-12: fresh (non-resume) run dispatches all stages ─────────────────────
392	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh non-resume run dispatches all stages (ADR-050 §6 new-run side)"
393	
394	S12_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-state"
395	S12_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-events"
396	S12_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
397	S12_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
398	mkdir -p "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S12_EVENTS_DIR"
399	
400	_S12_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
401	S12_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-fresh-work)"
402	# Use a cycle fixture so SPEC-12 and SPEC-13 use the same cyclic pipeline.
403	# artifact-snapshot-coverage has intake (leaf) + cyc (cycle); that satisfies SPEC-13.
404	install_template_overlay "$S12_WORK_REPO" artifact-snapshot-coverage
405	# cycled sub-stage of the cyc cycle declares roles:[builder]
406	mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
407	
408	# Fresh state: no completed stages. status=in_progress and no --resume flag →
409	# runner treats this as a new run; no stage should be skipped.
410	jq -n \
411	    --arg run_id "s12-fresh-1805" \
412	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
413	    --argjson issue "$_S12_ID" \
414	    '{
415	        schema_version: 1,
416	        run_id: $run_id,
417	        issue: $issue,
418	        stage_statuses: {},
419	        current_iteration: 0,
420	        self_heal_count: {},
421	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
422	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
423	        claim_lease_id: "",
424	        plugin_state: {},
425	        status: "in_progress",
426	        updated_at: $now
427	    }' > "$S12_STATE_FILE"
428	
429	# Run WITHOUT --resume: a fresh (non-resume) run.
430	# Contrast with SPEC-1 where a resumed run skips complete stages.
431	set +e
432	( cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && env \
433	    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
434	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
435	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR" \
436	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_FILE" \
437	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S12_EVENTS_DIR" \
438	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" \
439	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
440	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
441	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
442	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
443	    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --issue "$_S12_ID" ) \
444	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stderr.txt"
445	set -e
446	
447	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: intake must emit stage.start on a fresh run (not skipped by
448	# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
449	# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
450	# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
451	_s12_intake_starts=0
452	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
453	    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
454	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
455	fi
456	assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
457	    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"
458	
459	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
460	# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
461	_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
462	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
463	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
464	
465	# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
466	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"
467	
468	# SPEC-12 above installed artifact-snapshot-coverage into S12_WORK_REPO and ran a
469	# fresh pipeline against it. That fixture IS the cyclic pipeline this test uses.
470	# Verify it contains type: cycle (already read into _s12_fixt_content above).
471	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate test installs and runs a cyclic fixture (type: cycle)" \
472	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
473	
474	cleanup_test_env
475	print_test_results
476	exit $((FAIL > 0))
477

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: resume rehydrates completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch
# before the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-1 [code]: on resume, runner calls _artifact_persist_restore +
#   _artifact_persist_put_back and places completed-stage artifacts into
#   ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop; the complete stage emits
#   no stage.start event.
#
# SPEC-2 [code]: a complete stage whose primary artifact is absent from both
#   disk and the git state branch causes the resume to exit 1 before any
#   stage.start event is emitted.
#
# SPEC-5 [no-code]: ADR-006-resume-contract.md amended with step 3.5:
#   before the dispatch loop the runner restores completed-stage artifacts from
#   the git state branch; a still-absent artifact causes exit 1; enforcing
#   test names added inline.
#
# SPEC-6 [no-code]: ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6 amended with
#   boundary note: the invariant applies to new runs; a resume continues the
#   same run and is governed by ADR-006.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"
ZBUILD_CLI="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/zbuild"
ADR_006="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md"
ADR_050="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "resume-rehydrate — artifact restore on resume (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

_ZB_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"

# ── Shared infrastructure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Create a git repo that the runner will use (CWD of the subprocess).
# The state branch is written here; the runner also reads from here.
WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.name t

install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins (intake + build, each declaring a primary artifact).
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── SPEC-1: resume rehydrates artifacts from git state branch ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] resume restores completed-stage artifact into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR"

S1_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-state"
S1_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-events"
S1_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1_EVENTS_DIR"

# Write the intake primary artifact so the snapshot captures it.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot the artifact onto the state branch in WORK_REPO.
_s1_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1_STATE_DIR" "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s1_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: state branch populated with intake-result.json"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk to simulate the "artifacts not on disk" scenario.
rm -f "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_ZB_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner --resume. CWD=WORK_REPO so _artifact_persist_restore finds the
# state branch. Capture rc; do not abort on failure.
set +e
( cd "$WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --resume --issue "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stderr.txt"
_s1_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: artifact must be present in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after resume.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: rehydration copies artifact from state branch → PASSES.
assert_file_exists "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" \
    "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: intake must NOT have a stage.start event (it was complete and skipped).
_s1_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s1_intake_starts="$(grep -c '"type":"stage.start"' "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
        | xargs | grep -c '^[1-9]' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    # More precise: count stage.start events whose data.stage == "intake"
    _s1_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 2: auto-resume on status=interrupted ─────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 2 — auto-resume when status=interrupted.
# No --resume flag; runner detects interrupted status and auto-resumes.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: auto-resume (status=interrupted) restores artifacts"

S1P2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P2_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-state"
S1P2_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-events"
S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P2_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR"

S1P2_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p2)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p2_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P2_STATE_DIR" "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p2_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p2_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p2: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p2_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1p2-reh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P2_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --issue "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 artifact restored.
# Before change: no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume/interrupted): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p2_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s1p2_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): intake emits no stage.start (skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1p2_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id ───────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 3 — zbuild pipeline resume --run-id.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id restores artifacts"

S1P3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P3_RUN_ID="s1p3-reh-1805"
S1P3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-state"
S1P3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-events"
S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P3_STATE_FILE="$S1P3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR"

S1P3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p3)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P3_STATE_DIR" "$S1P3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p3: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p3_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P3_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$ZBUILD_CLI" pipeline resume \
        --run-id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
        --template runner-state-dir-minimal ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 artifact restored.
# Before change: zbuild resume path has no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p3_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s1p3_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): intake emits no stage.start (skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1p3_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-2: missing artifact causes resume to exit 1 ─────────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-2] missing artifact causes resume exit 1 before any stage.start"

S2_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-state"
S2_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-events"
S2_EVENTS_JSONL="$S2_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S2_STATE_FILE="$S2_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S2_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S2_EVENTS_DIR"

# Use a fresh WORK_REPO2 for SPEC-2 so SPEC-1's state branch is not present.
# A new issue identity guarantees no state branch exists.
_S2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
WORK_REPO2="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work2)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO2" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO2" config user.name t
install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO2" runner-state-dir-minimal

# State: intake=complete but NO artifact on disk and NO state branch.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s2-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S2_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$WORK_REPO2" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --resume --issue "$_S2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-stderr.txt"
_s2_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-2]: runner must exit 1 when artifact absent from disk AND state branch.
# Before the change: runner warns about stale artifact and continues → exits 0 → FAILS.
# After the change: runner exits 1 after failing to restore the artifact → PASSES.
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] resume exits 1 when primary artifact cannot be restored" \
    "1" "$_s2_rc"

# [#1805/SPEC-2]: no stage.start event must be emitted before the exit.
# (exit 1 happens before the dispatch loop reaches any stage)
_s2_any_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s2_any_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .type' \
        "$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] no stage.start emitted before exit 1" \
    "0" "$_s2_any_starts"

# ── SPEC-5: ADR-006 amended with artifact-restore step 3.5 ───────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 amended: step 3.5 restores artifacts before dispatch loop"

# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 must contain the amendment text describing artifact
# restoration in the resume sequence and exit 1 for an absent artifact.
# This passes after the doc change; it need not fail before.
_adr006="$(cat "$ADR_006" 2>/dev/null || true)"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 describes artifact restore before dispatch loop" \
    "$_adr006" "artifact"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 states absent artifact causes exit 1" \
    "$_adr006" "exit 1"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-rehydrate-test.sh as enforcing test" \
    "$_adr006" "resume-rehydrate-test.sh"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-entry-points-test.sh as enforcing test" \
    "$_adr006" "resume-entry-points-test.sh"

print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 amended with boundary note distinguishing resume from new runs"

_adr050_s6="$(awk \

    "$ADR_050" 2>/dev/null || true)"

# and that a resume is governed by ADR-006.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says invariant applies to new runs" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "new run"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note names ADR-006 as governing resume" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "ADR-006"

# ── SPEC-12: fresh (non-resume) run dispatches all stages ─────────────────────

S12_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-state"
S12_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-events"

mkdir -p "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S12_EVENTS_DIR"

_S12_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S12_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-fresh-work)"
# Use a cycle fixture so SPEC-12 and SPEC-13 use the same cyclic pipeline.
# artifact-snapshot-coverage has intake (leaf) + cyc (cycle); that satisfies SPEC-13.
install_template_overlay "$S12_WORK_REPO" artifact-snapshot-coverage
# cycled sub-stage of the cyc cycle declares roles:[builder]
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null

# runner treats this as a new run; no stage should be skipped.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s12-fresh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S12_ID" \

        run_id: $run_id,

        stage_statuses: {},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now

# Contrast with SPEC-1 where a resumed run skips complete stages.

( cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S12_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \

    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stderr.txt"

# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
_s12_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# SPEC-12 above installed artifact-snapshot-coverage into S12_WORK_REPO and ran a
# fresh pipeline against it. That fixture IS the cyclic pipeline this test uses.
# Verify it contains type: cycle (already read into _s12_fixt_content above).
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate test installs and runs a cyclic fixture (type: cycle)" \
    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: cycle orchestrator reads persisted current_iter and starts the
# iteration loop from that value (not 1) on resume. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-7 [code]: Cycle orchestrator reads cycle_iterations[CYCLE_ID].current_iter
#   from persisted state at resume and starts the iteration loop from that value
#   (not 1); iter-1 complete stages emit no stage.start on resume into iter-2.
#   Its test must FAIL on the code as it was before this change.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
FIXT="$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"

print_test_header "resume-loop-state — cycle orchestrator resumes from persisted iter (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-loop-state-1805"

export ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json"
export ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/events"
export ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/state"
mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR"

# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/template.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
# shellcheck source=../lib/cycle-report-stub.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/cycle-report-stub.sh"

STATE_FILE="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"

# ── SPEC-7: cycle starts from persisted current_iter on resume ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-7] cycle orchestrator resumes from current_iter (not 1)"

# Seed minimal state file required by _cycle_state_init.
: > "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL"
jq -n '{schema_version:1, stage_statuses:{}, updated_at:"seed"}' > "$STATE_FILE"

# Use zb_engine_loop_state to write one completed iteration (current_iter=1)
# into the state file. This simulates: iter-1 of the cycle has run and
# completed; the run was then interrupted before iter-2 dispatched.
# After the change the orchestrator will read current_iter=1 and start from
# iter-2 (current_iter + 1). Before the change it starts from iter=1.
zb_engine_loop_state "$STATE_FILE" "build-test" 1 5 "in_progress"

# Load the cycle template.
load_template "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml"

# Mock cycle_dispatch_stage: record the first iter dispatched, always pass.
# We record across all stages because the very first dispatch call reveals
# which iter the orchestrator started from.
_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=-1
cycle_dispatch_stage() {
    local stage="$1" iter="$2"
    if [[ "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" -eq -1 ]]; then
        _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER="$iter"
    fi
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS="complete"
    return 0
}

# The report stub makes the test member report zero test failures (pass).
zb_stub_reports_tests test

# Run the cycle orchestrator against the seeded state.
# Before this change: loop starts at iter=1 → first dispatch is iter=1.
# After this change: loop reads current_iter=1 → starts at iter=2 → first is 2.
set +e
cycle_orchestrator_run "build-test" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR" "$STATE_FILE"
_s7_rc=$?
set -e

# Before the change: _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=1 → assert 2==1 → FAILS.
# After the change:  _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=2 → assert 2==2 → PASSES.

    "[#1805/SPEC-7] first dispatched iter is 2 (resumed from current_iter=1, not restarted from 1)" \
    "2" "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER"

# (the orchestrator never ran iter-1, so it emits no completion for it).
_s7_iter1_complete=0
if [[ -f "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s7_iter1_complete="$(jq -r \
        'select(.type=="cycle.iteration.complete") | .data.iter // empty' \
        "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^1$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq \
    "[#1805/SPEC-7] no cycle.iteration.complete for iter=1 (iter-1 was already done before resume)" \
    "0" "$_s7_iter1_complete"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-loop-state test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# cycle-converges-iter2.yaml is loaded above via load_template and driven through
# cycle_orchestrator_run. Assert it contains type: cycle to formally pin the fixture
# contains a cyclic stage (as this test's SPEC-13 contract requires).
_s13_loop_fixt_content="$(cat "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] cycle fixture used by resume-loop-state test has type: cycle" \
    "$_s13_loop_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: all three resume entry paths invoke _runner_resume_rehydrate before
# the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-9 [code]: All three resume entry paths (--resume flag to runner.sh,
#   auto-resume on detecting status=interrupted, zbuild pipeline resume
#   --run-id) invoke _runner_resume_rehydrate before the dispatch loop.
#   Its test must FAIL on the code as it was before this change.
#
# Three sub-tests, each with a separate work repo, state dir, and events dir:
#   Path 1 — bash runner.sh --resume
#   Path 2 — bash runner.sh (no --resume; state status=interrupted → auto_resume)
#   Path 3 — bash zbuild pipeline resume --run-id
#
# Discriminating assertion for all paths: intake-result.json is present in
# ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after the runner call (artifact restored from state branch).
# Before this change: no rehydration → artifact absent → FAILS.
# After this change: _runner_resume_rehydrate restores it → PASSES.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"
ZBUILD_CLI="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/zbuild"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "resume-entry-points — all resume paths rehydrate artifacts (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-entry-points-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

# Common mock plugins for all three paths.
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── Shared helper: set up a work repo with a state branch for one path ──────────
# Usage: _setup_path_state <label> <issue_id> → sets:
#   P_WORK_REPO, P_STATE_DIR, P_STATE_FILE, P_EVENTS_DIR, P_EVENTS_JSONL
_setup_path_state() {
    local label="$1" issue_id="$2"

    P_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo "ep-${label}")"
    install_template_overlay "$P_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

    P_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-state"
    P_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-events"
    P_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
    P_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
    mkdir -p "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$P_EVENTS_DIR"

    # Write the intake artifact so the snapshot captures it.
    printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
        > "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

    # Snapshot onto the state branch.
    local _snap_rc=0
    ( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"
      cd "$P_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$P_STATE_DIR" "$issue_id" ) \
        >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>&1 || _snap_rc=$?
    if [[ "$_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
        assert_fail "setup-${label}: snapshot to state branch failed" \
            "rc=$_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
    fi

    # Remove artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
    rm -f "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
}

# ── PATH 1: --resume flag to runner.sh ────────────────────────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 1: bash runner.sh --resume restores artifacts"

P1_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_setup_path_state "p1" "$P1_ID"
P1_WORK_REPO="$P_WORK_REPO"
P1_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"
P1_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_FILE"
P1_EVENTS_DIR="$P_EVENTS_DIR"
P1_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_JSONL"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s9-p1-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$P1_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$P1_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$P1_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$P1_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$P1_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$P1_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$P1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --issue "$P1_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/p1-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/p1-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-9] path 1 assertion: artifact restored.
# Before change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After change: _runner_resume_rehydrate restores it → PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 1 (--resume flag): intake-result.json restored from state branch" \
    "$P1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# ── PATH 2: auto-resume on detecting status=interrupted ───────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 2: auto-resume on status=interrupted restores artifacts"

P2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_setup_path_state "p2" "$P2_ID"
P2_WORK_REPO="$P_WORK_REPO"
P2_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"
P2_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_FILE"
P2_EVENTS_DIR="$P_EVENTS_DIR"
P2_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_JSONL"

# status=interrupted → get_resume_recommendation → auto_resume → resume_mode=true.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s9-p2-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$P2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$P2_STATE_FILE"

# No --resume flag: runner detects status=interrupted and auto-resumes.
set +e
( cd "$P2_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$P2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$P2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$P2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$P2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/p2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/p2-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-9] path 2 assertion: artifact restored via auto-resume.
# Before change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After change: auto-resume path invokes _runner_resume_rehydrate → PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 2 (auto-resume/interrupted): intake-result.json restored from state branch" \
    "$P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# ── PATH 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id ───────────────────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id restores artifacts"

P3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_setup_path_state "p3" "$P3_ID"
P3_WORK_REPO="$P_WORK_REPO"
P3_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"
P3_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_FILE"
P3_EVENTS_DIR="$P_EVENTS_DIR"
P3_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_JSONL"
P3_RUN_ID="s9-p3-resume-1805"

# status=interrupted so zbuild doesn't refuse (aborted requires --force;
# interrupted is accepted). zbuild changes it to in_progress, then runner sees --resume.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$P3_RUN_ID" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$P3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$P3_STATE_FILE"

# zbuild pipeline resume reads ZBUILD_STATE_DIR and finds the state file by run_id.
# It sets status=in_progress and calls runner with --resume.
# The runner's CWD must be P3_WORK_REPO so _artifact_persist_restore finds the branch.
set +e
( cd "$P3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$P3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$P3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$P3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$ZBUILD_CLI" pipeline resume \
        --run-id "$P3_RUN_ID" \
        --template runner-state-dir-minimal ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/p3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/p3-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-9] path 3 assertion: artifact restored via zbuild pipeline resume.
# Before change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After change: zbuild pipeline resume → runner --resume → _runner_resume_rehydrate → PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): intake-result.json restored from state branch" \
    "$P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-entry-points test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# Install a cyclic fixture into a dedicated work repo to establish that this test
# file's setup installs a pipeline containing a cyclic stage (SPEC-13 requirement).
_S13_EP_WORK="$(setup_git_temp_repo ep-s13-cycle-check)"
install_template_overlay "$_S13_EP_WORK" artifact-snapshot-coverage
_s13_ep_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-entry-points test installs a fixture with type: cycle" \
    "$_s13_ep_content" "type: cycle"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

1	# ADR-050 — Prior-Work Reuse Contract (durable artifact store + per-stage self-seeding)
2	
3	**Status:** Accepted (2026-07-23)
4	**Amended:** 2026-10-13 (#2363) — §11: an attempt that ends in error leaves the stage's last good output in view; §9: what the issue's work has changed is said once, at the top of Previous work, against the commit the work started from — the per-stage "what moved since it last ran" line and its record are gone.
5	**Amended:** 2026-10-12 (ADR-067 §8 prompt contract) — §9: a rerun of an issue continues it. Hydrate puts an earlier run's outputs back in their live places; there is no separate restored area, no "earlier run" label, and a stage judges or refines the latest output whichever run wrote it. §5's restored tier and §8 are withdrawn.
6	**Amended:** 2026-10-06 (#2326) — §8: anything a stage reads from an earlier run's saved work is labelled as that run's, for reference only, wherever it shows (input index, prompts, input events), and a stage that judges results never counts it as this run's result.
7	**Amended:** 2026-10-06 (#2324) — design-gate no longer writes `data.design_sha`; its only reader was the reuse rule #2299 withdrew. Every statement below now names its test.
8	**Amended:** 2026-10-05 (#2299) — design always runs. The #2225 rule that kept a prior run's design without a model call is withdrawn; a restored design reaches the prompt as a reference to check (§6: never skip the stage on the basis of prior output).
9	**Amended:** 2026-09-16 (#2111) — a run that ends `aborted` with `reason=llm_rate_limited` (ADR-054 §6) persists like any other outcome; re-adding the trigger label after the reset resumes from the state branch. The daemon's completion comment names the reset text so the operator knows when.
10	**Amended:** 2026-08-23 (#141) — §7: git is the store, the folder is the working copy, and the push moves from CI into an always-run `persist` stage (ADR-059)
11	
12	**Confirmed unchanged:** 2026-08-12 (#1768, ADR-055 §1.2) — ADR-055's data contract was reviewed against this one and prior-work reuse is deliberately **outside the input model**. It is not a declared input, not a third source kind, and not `external`. §1 below is the reason: a stage detects *its own* prior artifact in its own working area, so there is no producer to resolve and no wire to declare. Modelling it as an input would require the engine to know that `build`'s prior `build_summary` belongs to `build` — exactly what §1 forbids. No change to this ADR.
13	
14	> **Memory type.** This ADR governs **prior-work memory** — the durable output of a
15	> prior run of the _same issue_ (a design.md, a work branch, an open PR) that a
16	> later run reuses as advisory seed. It is distinct from the **pipeline-resume
17	> memory** of [ADR-006](ADR-006-resume-contract.md): resume _skips_ completed
18	> stages to continue an interrupted run; this contract makes every stage _re-run_,
19	> seeded from prior work. The two are orthogonal and may coexist.
20	
21	## Context
22	
23	Re-triggering a dogfood for an issue that already had a run threw the prior work
24	away or aborted: CI `state/` is ephemeral (gitignored), so plan/design/impact/etc.
25	were regenerated from scratch; intake refused an existing remote branch; and the
26	PR stage aborted when a PR already existed. The observed cost was real — a correct
27	~2-hour run (issue #1569) was discarded and re-done, then aborted on a stale PR.
28	
29	We want the opposite: **every stage runs, and each stage picks up its own prior
30	work as advisory input** ("reference it, don't blindly trust it, improve from
31	there"), identically locally and in GitHub CI, and for BOTH intra-cycle iterations
32	and cross-run restarts — through one mechanism, not two code paths.
33	
34	This must hold without violating the plugin contract ([ADR-001](ADR-001-plugin-contract.md))
35	or the stage-agnostic mechanics rule ([ADR-047](ADR-047-stage-agnostic-mechanics.md)):
36	the engine must not learn stage names or artifact meanings.
37	
38	## Decision
39	
40	### 1. Two layers, strict separation
41	
42	- **Engine / orchestrator = generic, stage-agnostic persistence.** It never knows
43	  which stages exist or what any artifact means. Its sole job: whatever a stage
44	  saved to the run's artifact area is preserved and restored into a consistent
45	  location so it is available to a later run. It snapshots a _directory_; it never
46	  branches on stage identity.
47	- **Stage plugin = self-detection + consumption.** A stage knows only ITS OWN
48	  artifact. It asks "is my prior output present in my working area?" and, if coded
49	  to, reuses it as advisory seed. A stage NEVER reaches into pipeline state, run
50	  history, or resume logic — detection is just "does my file exist here?", which
51	  the engine's generic restore guarantees.
52	
53	### 2. Durable store = a separate state branch (never merged to main)
54	
55	The engine persists the artifact area to a sibling branch **`zbuild/state/issue-<N>`**,
56	distinct from the work branch `zbuild/issue-<N>-ci`.
57	
58	- It is **never part of the work branch's history**, so it cannot merge to main and
59	  never pollutes the PR diff. (Legacy shipwright committed state into the _work_
60	  branch with no strip-before-merge, so its snapshots would reach main; the separate
61	  branch fixes that while keeping the "durable on a branch, restored by fetch" shape.)
62	- It is a real branch (not a hidden `refs/…` ref) so a stored document has a
63	  browsable GitHub blob URL — e.g. design.md is linkable.
64	- Snapshots use git plumbing (`hash-object` → `commit-tree` → `update-ref`) so they
65	  **never touch the working tree or the real index**. Restore uses `git archive`.
66	
67	### 3. What is stored, and what is NOT
68	
69	- **Stored (durable):** the work branch (code commits), the GitHub PR, and the
70	  snapshotted artifact area (each stage's primary artifact — plan.json, design.md,
71	  impact.json, build-summary.json, lens-*.json, scope-manifest.md, …).
72	- **Not reused (always re-evaluated fresh):** the verdicts of **deterministic
73	  gates** — test, shape-floor, acceptance-gate, secret-scan, gate-aggregator,
74	  design-gate, review-aggregator. They are cheap and deterministic, and reusing a
75	  stale "pass" against changed code is a correctness hazard (it produced observed
76	  false-greens). Gates re-run against current git state every time.
77	
78	### 4. Persist timing
79	
80	Commit a snapshot at **each stage boundary** (so a mid-run crash/rate-limit still
81	leaves every completed stage recoverable); **push the state branch once at the end**,
82	pass or fail (reusing the existing `if: always()` push step). Identical snapshots
83	are no-ops (no empty commits).
84	
85	**Amendment (#1878) — the snapshot was never invoked at all.** As shipped in #1581
86	its only call site sat inside the runner's **legacy linear stage loop**
87	(`runner.sh`, the `for stage in "${active_stages[@]}"` loop). That loop is
88	unreachable for every shipped template: a template containing a `cycle:`, `map:` or
89	`parallel:` unit sets `_run_dispatch_units=1`, and every terminal branch of the
90	dispatch-unit block above it returns. Both `simple.yaml` and `deployed.yaml` yield
91	cycle units, so the linear loop never executes — and the store was therefore always
92	empty, which is why the restore on the live path always found nothing. This is item
93	1 of #1807.
94	
95	The snapshot is now one helper (`_runner_snapshot_artifacts`) invoked from the
96	**live** dispatch-unit completion sites — the `stage:` arm (leaf stages: intake,
97	plan, impact, pr), the parallel-group arm, the map-group arm — and from the cycle
98	orchestrator's single member-completion funnel
99	(`_cycle_emit_member_dispatch_complete`, rc=0 only, matching the leaf contract) so
100	that `design`, `design-gate` and the whole of `build_test_cycle` are covered.
101	
102	The call in the legacy loop is left in place and now routes through the same helper:
103	it is unreachable today, but leaving a *divergent* copy behind is how this class of
104	defect is manufactured. #1807 owns removing the loop; until then the two paths agree.
105	
106	**Amendment (#1878) — persistence is advisory but never silent.** A snapshot
107	reports one of `saved | empty | unchanged | failed` on
108	`_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS`, and a failure carries the failing git operation
109	and its stderr on `_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON`. The engine emits
110	`artifact.snapshot.failed` / `artifact.restore.failed` accordingly. Previously the
111	call site swallowed stderr and the library returned `0` for genuine no-ops, so the
112	engine reported `artifact.snapshot.saved` for a snapshot that had saved nothing —
113	and a real failure produced no signal anywhere. A single unstageable file now
114	skips-and-counts rather than discarding the whole snapshot.
115	
116	**Amendment (#1921) — persist's own result joins the store, and what `pushed: null` means.**
117	Every stage's result file reaches the state branch except the one whose job is
118	durability. `persist_run` wrote `persist-result.json` *after* its only snapshot, so
119	the snapshot could never contain it, and the work branch carries code only —
120	measured on `zbuild/state/issue-1836`: 90 commits, eight `*-result.json` files, no
121	`persist-result.json` in any of them. The stage with no durable record of itself is
122	the one an operator most needs a record of, because its failure mode is silence.
123	
124	The order is now: snapshot → **write the result** → snapshot again → secret gate →
125	push **once** (§4 unchanged) → rewrite the local copy with the push outcome. The
126	second snapshot exists because the first cannot contain the file that describes it.
127	The gate moved *after* the write so it scans `persist-result.json` too — nothing
128	reaches origin unscanned.
129	
130	**The second snapshot AMENDS the first rather than stacking on it**, so the branch
131	gains exactly **one** commit per persist run. A second commit whose only delta is a
132	status file is precisely the empty-commit spam this section already rules out.
133	Amend is opt-in per call and used *only* when the caller created the current tip in
134	that same invocation: when persist's own snapshot reports `unchanged` or `empty` it
135	created nothing, the tip belongs to an earlier stage boundary, and amending there
136	would silently delete a legitimate commit. In that case the second snapshot extends
137	normally — still one commit.
138	
139	**The branch copy carries `data.pushed: null`, and that does not mean the push
140	failed.** A push cannot record its own outcome; recording `false` would be a lie
141	whenever the push then succeeded, which is the common case. The authoritative value
142	is in the **local** `persist-result.json` and in the CI job log. `null` reads as
143	"not attempted at the time this was written". Anything reading the branch copy and
144	treating `null` as failure is reading it wrong — this paragraph exists because that
145	misreading is the same class of defect #1921 was filed to eliminate.
146	
147	Note this is *stored, not reused* — the same category §3 already puts deterministic
148	gate verdicts in. Nothing seeds from it; it is a record.
149	
150	**Amendment (#1878) — push order.** The state-branch push runs **before** the
151	work-branch push in `zbuild-pipeline.yml`. Both live in one `run:` block and the
152	work push legitimately `exit 1`s on failure, which previously skipped the state
153	push entirely — the durable store was sacrificed to a work-branch failure, which is
154	precisely the case it exists to survive (observed on run 31798796692, where the work
155	push was rejected under #1780).
156	
157	### 5. The unified prior-output seam (one path for cycle AND restart)
158	
159	Consuming stages read prior work through a single helper
160	`scripts/lib/prior-output-reader.sh` → `_read_prior_output <artifact>`, with one
161	resolution order (first hit wins):
162	
163	1. **This run's latest output** (`${ZBUILD_STATE_DIR}/artifacts/<artifact>`) — the
164	   file the stage wrote, on any try of any loop. (Amended 2026-10-11, ADR-068 §8:
165	   the intra-cycle copy `ZBUILD_CYCLE_FEEDBACK_DIR/prior_<field>.txt` and the
166	   attempt-record fallback are removed; the engine keeps no copy of a stage's
167	   output. #2252 had already put this run's own output before the restored one.)
168	2. ~~**Cross-run restored** (`ZBUILD_RESTORED_ARTIFACTS_DIR/<artifact>`)~~ — withdrawn
169	   by §9 (2026-10-12): hydrate puts an earlier run's outputs in their live
170	   places, so tier 1 is the only one.
171	3. Not found → empty, `return 0` (silent-fail).
172	
173	A stage does not choose _which_ source supplied the content; it injects the
174	result into its prompt as an advisory `## PRIOR <X>` section. Amended by §8
175	(#2326): when the source is the earlier run's copy, the section says so —
176	`_prior_output_path` returns the path, and `prior_output_is_earlier_run` tells
177	the stage which kind it got.
178	
179	### 6. Stage-authoring contract (what a new stage MUST do)
180	
181	A plugin author, when creating or changing a stage, MUST observe:
182	
183	- **Declare a primary artifact** (manifest `outputs:` with `primary: true`). That
184	  file — and only what the stage writes to the artifact area — is what gets
185	  snapshotted. The engine needs no per-stage code.
186	- **To reuse prior work**, read via `_read_prior_output` and treat the result as
187	  **advisory** ("reference, don't fully trust; verify against current inputs").
188	  Never skip the stage on the basis of prior output; never read pipeline/run state.
189	- **If the stage is a deterministic gate**, it MUST re-evaluate current state and
190	  MUST NOT reuse a prior verdict.
191	- **Never write anything that must not reach main into the work branch** — durable
192	  cross-run state belongs on the state branch (engine-managed), not in the code diff.
193	
194	### 7. Amendment (#141) — git is the store, the folder is the working copy, and every run pushes
195	
196	**Status:** Accepted (2026-08-23). See [ADR-059](ADR-059-issue-vs-run-keying.md) §3.
197	
198	This ADR is already keyed by the issue, so ADR-059's layout does not compete with it. What ADR-059
199	settles is **which of the two is authoritative**, because there are now two places an issue's prior
200	work can live: the state branch above, and the on-disk `issues/<N>/artifacts/` directory.
201	
202	**Git is the store. The folder is the working copy. On a disagreement, git wins.**
203	
204	The disk is not a second store and does not gain independent authority by being closer to hand. It
205	is what a run reads and writes during its life; §2's branch is what survives it.
206	
207	**The push moves out of CI and into the pipeline.** §4 says *"push the state branch once at the end,
208	pass or fail"*, and the #1878 amendments below add ordering and advisory-failure rules on top of it —
209	all of which read as engine behaviour. They are not. `core/state/artifact-persist.sh` has **no `git
210	push`**; it writes a local ref. The only state-branch push in the repository is a shell block in
211	`.github/workflows/zbuild-pipeline.yml`. A local run therefore snapshots to a branch nobody ever
212	sends anywhere, which is why #1921 measured hundreds of local commits and zero on origin.
213	
214	ADR-059 §3 fixes this by making persistence a **stage** rather than engine code:
215	
216	- **hydrate**, before intake — pulls the state branch into the folder. Git wins; it overwrites.
217	- **release**, at the end, **always-run**, short timeout — frees live resources, deletes nothing.
218	- **persist**, at the end after release, **always-run**, longer timeout — snapshots **and pushes**.
219	
220	`_artifact_persist_restore` (`core/pipeline/runner.sh:1813`) becomes hydrate; the RUN-END snapshot
221	and the push become persist. This file stays as the shared library both stages source.
222	
223	**Corrected 2026-08-23 (#1071).** An earlier draft said `_runner_snapshot_artifacts` "becomes
224	persist", which reads as moving it wholesale. §4's per-stage-boundary snapshots — six call sites —
225	are that section's own design and **stay engine-side**. The persist stage owns what never existed:
226	a final snapshot at run end, and the push. `_artifact_persist_push` is new in this file; nothing
227	in it has ever pushed before. The #1878 amendments survive intact and finally have somewhere to be enforced: the
228	push-order rule becomes stage order in the template, and the "advisory but never silent" rule
229	becomes the persist stage's own disposition.
230	
231	**§3's exclusion is unchanged and gets no relaxation here.** Deterministic gate verdicts are still
232	*"always re-evaluated fresh"*. That rule exists because reuse produced **observed** false greens, and
233	a durable, pushed, cross-machine store makes stale-verdict leakage easier rather than harder.
234	Widening what may be reused is a separate decision from moving where work lives, and must not ride
235	along with it.
236	
237	**A hazard was flagged here and is now DISPROVEN — recorded rather than deleted, because the
238	reasoning is what stops it being re-invented.** The claim was: *git wins* plus *persist failed*
239	loses unpushed work, because a re-run would overwrite newer local artifacts with an older git copy.
240	Building #1074 showed the sequence cannot happen:
241	
242	- **Restore never writes over live artifacts.** It extracts into a separate `restored-artifacts/`
243	  area, and `input-resolve.sh` reads the live path first — a stage's own output is never replaced
244	  by an older copy of itself.
245	- **Fetch cannot move a local snapshot.** `git fetch` updates only the remote-tracking ref;
246	  `refs/heads/<branch>` is untouched, so unpushed work survives.
247	- **The local ref wins on read, deliberately.** `_artifact_persist_restore` prefers
248	  `refs/heads/<branch>` over `refs/remotes/origin/<branch>` precisely because the local one may hold
249	  more. "Git wins" is about **durability** — where work survives a dead laptop — not about read
250	  precedence.
251	
252	So hydrate needs no "local is newer" detector and persist needs no failure marker. What hydrate
253	does need, and what was actually missing, is the **fetch**: on a fresh clone neither ref exists, so
254	restore reported "first run" for an issue with plenty of prior work.
255	
256	### 8. Amendment (#2326) — an earlier run's work is labelled, and never counted as this run's result
257	
258	**Status:** Withdrawn 2026-10-12 by §9. Accepted (2026-10-06). The same rule ADR-063 §5 (#2325) applies across the rounds of one run,
259	applied across runs.
260	
261	A stage may read what an earlier run saved (restored into `$ZBUILD_RESTORED_ARTIFACTS_DIR`). That work
262	was not produced by this run, and the earlier run's result may not have been accepted. Until #2326
263	nothing said so: a declared input with no copy from this run fell back to the earlier run's copy
264	silently (#2095 keeps that fallback), the index and the prompt listed it like any other input, and
265	review-aggregator would have counted a lens's verdict from last run for a lens that wrote nothing this
266	run.
267	
268	- **Labelled everywhere it shows.** One wording, defined once (`ZB_EARLIER_RUN_LABEL` in
269	  `scripts/lib/prior-output-reader.sh`): *"from an earlier run — reference only, not this run's
270	  result"*.
271	  - The input index (`stage-inputs/<stage>.json`) lists every path served from an earlier run's copy
272	    under `earlier_run`. A path from this run is not listed; with none, the key is absent.
273	  - The prompt's input block puts the label next to each such path and says what it means.
274	  - The engine records each one as a `stage.input.earlier_run` event (`stage`, `input`, `path`).
275	  - A stage that seeds itself from its own earlier work — design, plan, impact, build's prior summary —
276	    labels it when it came from an earlier run, and only then.
277	  - Notes an earlier run saved as it went (the checkpoint, ADR-063 §5) appear under
278	    `### NOTES FROM AN EARLIER RUN (reference only)`, not as this stage's own exploration to build on.
279	- **Never counted as this run's result.** A stage that judges results — a gate (`convergence: gate`) or
280	  a stage that aggregates others' results (`aggregates:`, e.g. review-aggregator) — is never handed an
281	  earlier run's copy. For it, a result this run did not produce is missing: an optional input is
282	  handed over as this run's (absent) path, and a required one refuses the dispatch (`INPUT_MISSING`).
283	  This extends §3 from the gate's own verdict to every result a gate reads.
284	- **Hand-overs keep working.** A stage that does not judge still reads the earlier copy when this run
285	  has none (#2095); it is labelled, not withheld.
286	
287	### 9. Amendment (2026-10-12) — a rerun of an issue continues it
288	
289	**Status:** Accepted (2026-10-12). Supersedes §5's restored tier and §8.
290	
291	An earlier run's outputs are earlier versions of each stage's output, exactly as an earlier try in the
292	same run is. One rule covers both: **a stage's latest output is the live file, whichever try or run wrote
293	it** (ADR-068 §8).
294	
295	- **Hydrate puts them in the live places.** The hydrate stage extracts the state branch to a staging
296	  folder and copies every file into the run's `artifacts/`, skipping any the run already has (a live
297	  file is this run's own, and newer). `stage-io/` is left out: it records one run's model calls and is
298	  no stage's output (amended 2026-10-14, after #1801's rerun shipped a two-day-old one). There is no `restored-artifacts/` area and no
299	  `ZBUILD_RESTORED_ARTIFACTS_DIR`; the reader (§5), the input index and design read one place.
300	- **No label.** Nothing says "from an earlier run". Previous work opens with one line naming the files
301	  this issue's work has changed so far, against where its branch left the default branch, so a rerun
302	  still lists what earlier runs committed (amended 2026-10-14; it compared against the commit intake
303	  recorded, and #1801's rerun said "none") — the same for every stage, so said once (ADR-067 §8, amended 2026-10-13 by #2363; until then
304	  each stage carried its own "since it last ran" line and a per-stage record of it). The issue text is
305	  read once per run, so no line says whether it changed.
306	- **A result still counts only if its stage's latest run wrote it.** A stage that runs again and writes
307	  no result has none (`stage_result_is_current`, ADR-068 §8) — that safeguard is per dispatch and
308	  unchanged.
309	- **Intake always reads the live issue** (it already did, failing closed on an unreadable one, #1804).
310	
311	### 10. Amendment (2026-10-12) — no changes, no save
312	
313	**Status:** Accepted (2026-10-12).
314	
315	Nothing is saved unless the run has changed it. A snapshot whose content matches the state branch's tip
316	makes no commit (§4, already so). The run's code reaches its work branch only when HEAD carries commits
317	past the commit the run started from, which the engine sets before any stage (`ZBUILD_RUN_START_COMMIT`,
318	ADR-052 amendment #2367; intake recorded it until then); with no starting commit set, a stage end pushes
319	nothing. #1801 run 38290215955 broke
320	this: the end of hydrate, which runs before intake, found no baseline, skipped the check, and
321	force-pushed main over the branch's six earlier commits, so plan was handed an earlier run's findings
322	about code that was no longer there.
323	
324	### 11. Amendment (2026-10-13, #2363) — a failed attempt leaves the last good output in view
325	
326	**Status:** Accepted (2026-10-13).
327	
328	An attempt that ends in error produced no output, so it must not hide the output the stage last did
329	produce. The live result file still says the attempt failed — the engine reads its verdict as it does
330	every result — and Previous work, under that stage, also lists **its last good output, from an earlier
331	attempt**: the files of the newest archived attempt (`artifacts/attempts/<stage>/…`, every dispatch's
332	own copy, #2183) whose primary result is not an error and that holds every output the stage marks
333	`required: true`, not empty, and that output's summary (amended 2026-10-14: #1801's rerun named attempts
334	that had written no design.md). #1801's plan timed
335	out four times; each attempt's error record replaced the one plan it had written, so the next attempt
336	had no plan to keep.
337	
338	A stage that writes its output as it works keeps what it wrote: a valid output on disk that the attempt
339	wrote counts, even when the attempt's model call was cut off (plan, #2363; design, whose prompt since
340	#2376 tells it to write design.md early and update it as it goes).
341	
342	## Consequences
343	
344	- Re-triggering an issue continues the prior attempt instead of restarting it:
345	  intake adopts the existing branch, stages seed from prior artifacts, the PR is
346	  updated rather than duplicated.
347	- The engine stays stage-agnostic (upholds ADR-047); the plugin contract (ADR-001)
348	  gains an artifact/reuse obligation but no new engine coupling.
349	- The state branch accrues history per issue; it is disposable and never merged.
350	- Deterministic-gate freshness is guaranteed, avoiding stale-pass false-greens.
351	- A new operational branch namespace (`zbuild/state/*`) must be excluded from any
352	  label/PR automation and from branch-cleanup that assumes work branches.
353	
354	## Implementation Notes (#1581 / PR #1582)
355	
356	Foundation landed in PR #1582:
357	
358	- `scripts/lib/prior-output-reader.sh` — `_read_prior_output` (the unified seam, §5).
359	- `core/state/artifact-persist.sh` — `_artifact_persist_snapshot` / `_artifact_persist_restore`
360	  (git-plumbing snapshot to `zbuild/state/issue-<N>`, working-tree-safe; §2, §4).
361	- `plugins/agent/intake/plugin.sh` — adopts an existing remote work branch
362	  (`intake.branch.adopted`) instead of refusing.
363	- `plugins/tool/pr-open/plugin.sh` — reuses an existing open PR (`status=updated`)
364	  instead of aborting.
365	
366	Follow-up — LANDED (makes the foundation live):
367	
368	- Runner integration (`core/pipeline/runner.sh`): restore prior artifacts once at
369	  startup, exporting `ZBUILD_RESTORED_ARTIFACTS_DIR` at the restored `artifacts/`
370	  subdir; snapshot the artifact area to the state branch at each completed stage
371	  boundary. Both best-effort and stage-agnostic (the engine names no stage).
372	- Consumer wiring: design & build route their existing prior-work readers through
373	  `_read_prior_output` (design also emits a state-branch blob link); plan, impact,
374	  and review-lens read their own prior artifact and inject a `## PRIOR X` section —
375	  gated on `ZBUILD_RESTORED_ARTIFACTS_DIR` (cross-run restore only) so a leaf stage
376	  never picks up stale cycle env or its own same-run output.
377	- CI workflow (`.github/workflows/zbuild-pipeline.yml`): fetch the work + state
378	  branches into remote-tracking refs before the run (so intake can ADOPT the work
379	  branch and the runner can RESTORE the state branch); push the state branch pass
380	  OR fail.
381	- pr-open: the 0-commit preflight is remote-aware — if `origin/<work-branch>` has
382	  commits it proceeds to reuse/open the PR instead of aborting (fixes the #1570
383	  cold-start "nothing to ship").
384	
385	Deterministic gates are intentionally left to re-evaluate fresh (§3).
386	
387	## Amendment (2026-09-29, #2225): the run's resume intent reaches every stage
388	
389	Prior-work reuse had no switch a stage could see. After a usage-limit abort,
390	re-adding `zbuild-run` starts a new run that `hydrate` seeds with the old
391	artifacts — but nothing told a stage it was a resume, so design ran again every
392	time (~20 min on #1835 and #1837) and the loop's rounds reset.
393	
394	- **One variable, `ZBUILD_RESUME`**, exported by the runner before any stage
395	  runs: `1` by default (reuse prior work), `0` with `--no-resume` — and
396	  `ZBUILD_RESUME=0` in the environment is the same as the flag, as
397	  `ZBUILD_SELF_HOST=1` is for `--self-host`. The pipeline workflow has a
398	  `no_resume` input (like `dry_run`); the daemon leaves the default.
399	- **`0` recreates.** `hydrate` restores nothing. It still fetches and adopts the
400	  saved-work history, so the next snapshot extends it instead of force-pushing a
401	  new one over it (review #2229).
402	- **Each stage decides what `1` means for it.** Plan continues from its
403	  checkpoint; test-author and build from their committed files. design
404	  always runs (amended by #2299, below): the restored design is in its prompt
405	  as a reference, never kept as this run's design.
406	
407	Verification: `tests/unit/resume-default-test.sh` (R1–R4).
408	
409	## Amendment (2026-10-05, #2299): design always runs
410	
411	The #2225 bullet above first let design keep the prior run's design without a
412	model call when design-gate had passed that exact `design.md`, spec-coverage had
413	found it covered, this run had no design yet, and `intake.md` was unchanged.
414	That rule never asked whether the run that wrote the design succeeded, or
415	whether the design was ever built and tested. #2035 run 37289704344 kept run
416	37262225813's design in 1 second; that design had been rewritten in the failed
417	run's last round (SPEC-2/3 relabelled `[guard]`), never tested, and the relabel
418	went straight into PR #2298. The prompt already tells the model to treat a
419	prior design as a reference to verify against the current inputs; a skip means
420	no model ever reads that line.
421	
422	- **design makes its model call on every run**, resumed or not. It emits no
423	  `design.reused` (the event is gone).
424	- **A restored prior design is a reference.** It reaches the prompt under
425	  `## PRIOR DESIGN (a previous attempt on this issue — a hypothesis, not a
426	  fact)`, with what has moved since, as §6 and #2172 require.
427	- design-gate no longer records the hash of the `design.md` it judged
428	  (`data.design_sha`, removed by #2324): nothing read it once the reuse rule
429	  was gone.
430	
431	## Enforced by
432	
433	- §1 (the engine snapshots a directory, never a stage: files with names no stage has round-trip; the persistence code names no plugin) → `tests/unit/prior-work-reuse-contract-test.sh` C1
434	- §2 (state branch, never in work-branch history; snapshots never touch the working tree) → `tests/unit/artifact-persist-test.sh`
435	- §3 (a deterministic gate never reuses a prior verdict: no gate plugin reads prior work; design-gate and gate-aggregator judge the current state despite a restored pass) → `tests/unit/prior-work-reuse-contract-test.sh` C3
436	- §4 (a snapshot at each stage boundary; a failed snapshot never aborts the run) → `tests/integration/artifact-snapshot-runner-test.sh`
437	- §4 (#1921: persist's own result joins the store; the secret gate runs before the push) → `tests/unit/persist-stage-test.sh`
438	- §5 (`_read_prior_output` order; no restored tier, §9) → `tests/unit/prior-output-reader-test.sh` T2; `tests/unit/own-run-artifacts-first-test.sh` O5–O8
439	- §6 (never skip a stage on the basis of prior output — design always runs, the prior design is a reference in its prompt) → `tests/unit/resume-default-test.sh` R5–R11 (#2299)
440	- §7 (persist is an always-run stage) → `tests/unit/template-always-run-test.sh`
441	- §10 (no changes, no save: with no starting commit set a stage end pushes nothing and the work branch on origin is untouched; with no commits past it, nothing is pushed) → `tests/unit/stage-work-saved-test.sh` SPEC-8, SPEC-9
442	- §10 (the starting commit is set by the engine before any stage, hydrate included) → `tests/integration/engine-run-branch-test.sh` E1
443	- §7 (the local ref wins on read: unpushed local work is what restore returns) → `tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh` SPEC-2
444	- Implementation notes (the run adopts an existing remote work branch; the engine since #2367) → `tests/integration/run-branch-ahead-count-test.sh`
445	- Implementation notes (pr-open edits the existing open PR, never opens a second, and reports `status=updated`) → `tests/unit/prior-work-reuse-contract-test.sh` C5
446	- #2225 (`ZBUILD_RESUME` defaults to 1; `--no-resume` restores nothing yet still fetches and adopts) → `tests/unit/resume-default-test.sh` R1–R4
447	- #2324 (design-gate's result has no `design_sha`) → `tests/unit/resume-default-test.sh` R12
448	- §9 (hydrate puts an earlier run's outputs in the live places, keeping any the run already has; no restored area; stage-io/ is not put back) → `tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh` SPEC-1, SPEC-6, SPEC-7; `tests/integration/prior-work-reuse-integration-test.sh` T4, T5
449	- §9 (no restored area is read: the index and the reader see only the live file) → `tests/unit/stage-input-resolve-precedence-test.sh` SPEC-3; `tests/unit/own-run-artifacts-first-test.sh` O1, O7
450	- §9 (no earlier-run label; one wording for design's latest design whichever run wrote it) → `tests/unit/stage-prompt-contract-test.sh` P2; `tests/unit/design-prior-hypothesis-test.sh` SPEC-5
451	- §9 (what the issue's work has changed, said once at the top against the default branch; no per-stage line or record) → `tests/unit/engine-blocks-shared-only-test.sh` B2, B2b; `tests/unit/stage-blocks-dispatch-test.sh` D2
452	- §11 (an attempt that ended in error shows the stage's last good output and its summary; the failure is still shown; an attempt missing a required output is not good) → `tests/unit/engine-blocks-shared-only-test.sh` B3, B3b
453	- §11 (a valid output the attempt wrote counts even when its call was cut off; one it did not write does not) → design: `tests/unit/design-writes-as-it-goes-test.sh` D4 (plan's W3–W5, I2, I3 went with the plan stage, #2445)
454	- #2111 (a run aborted with `llm_rate_limited` persists — persist pushes the state branch; the daemon's completion comment names the reset time and says to re-add the label) → `tests/unit/prior-work-reuse-contract-test.sh` C6
455	
456	## References
457
